units.source_text: 火葬场在村庄东南突出的海角尽头净是石头的小海滨上。

en.t: The cremation ground was on a small, rocky beach at the tip of a cape jutting out to the southeast of the village.

units.source_text: 所以焚烧的烟灰不会吹向村庄方面。

en.t: So the ashes from the burning would not blow toward the village.

units.source_text: 大概由于这个缘故，自古以来这里就被用做火葬场。

en.t: Probably for that reason, the place had been used as a cremation ground since ancient times.
